articles.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
articles.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

articles.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
articles.summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

articles.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
articles.summary: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
articles.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

articles.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
articles.summary: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.

articles.title: GM to close Detroit battery-assembly plant, but not for reasons you might think
articles.summary: GM is shuttering the Brownstown Battery Assembly Plant, though the closure has nothing to do with the automaker's electrification strategy.

articles.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
articles.summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

articles.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
articles.summary: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

articles.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
articles.summary: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

articles.title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself
articles.summary: JustWatch, the popular streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service, offering free, ad-supported movies and shows alongside a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier and movie rentals.

articles.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language

articles.title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation

articles.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
articles.summary: The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
